description: Parses a resume PDF from a given URL, extracts text, and uses OpenAI to return structured candidate data including personal details, skills with classifications, and total years of experience

Generates LinkedIn Boolean search queries and filter recommendations from job attributes and requirements, ensuring mandatory skills and roles are included while providing guidance for applying non-Boolean filters.
[DEPRECATED] Original match analysis API. Replaced by match-analysis-pdf and match-analysis-linkedin for specialized candidate evaluation.
Generates personalized recruitment emails (client or candidate) using job, optional candidate, and sender info, returning a JSON with a crafted subject and body following tone/style guidelines.

Generates 12 structured screening questions tailored to the job’s requirements and context—exactly two each for technical, problem_solving, communication, leadership, learning, and cultural—and returns them as JSON.

Converts raw LinkedIn profile JSON into a simplified shape for Vita: normalizes core fields, extracts plain-text descriptions from nested subComponents in experiences, and returns a cleaned profile object. Also validates input (e.g., names, non-empty experiences) and errors on invalid payloads. This endpoint output is mainly used as the endpoint's 'parse-linkedin-skill' input.

Parses a reduced LinkedIn profile JSON and uses OpenAI to extract structured candidate data (main info, skills with types/yoe/proficiency, total years), normalizing soft skills/certifications to nulls. Returns a clean JSON payload with CORS and input validation built-in.

Parses raw job content plus company, industry, and optional culture with OpenAI to produce a structured JSON of job attributes (title, rate, location, etc.) and weighted requirements with proficiency levels. Returns the cleaned JSON for use in the app.

Analyzes PDF resume text against job requirements using two-tier scoring (mandatory vs optional). Features evidence extraction with company attribution, semantic skill matching via OpenAI embeddings, and generates recruiter feedback with specific resume quotes and role inference.

Evaluates LinkedIn profiles against job requirements with enhanced evidence extraction. Processes structured LinkedIn data, provides company-attributed skill evidence, career progression analysis, and professional role inference with recruiter recommendations.

Third-party service for scraping LinkedIn profiles. Extracts structured profile data including experiences, skills, education, and recommendations. Used as data source for match-analysis-linkedin API processing.

Generates a polished job description from structured attributes & requirements (plus optional notes), returning { job_description } JSON with company/role overview, requirements, and highlights. Handles CORS, validates POST input, and uses OpenAI to produce the content.
